description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Avatar Kyoshi and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.
